typography.monospace_font: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace
typography.body: 14px font size, 1.5 line-height. Used for standard data representation.
typography.financial_data: ALWAYS use monospace font for IDs, UTRs, settlement references, and paise values.
typography.anti_patterns: Do NOT use massive text sizes. Keep scales institutional (max text-2xl or text-3xl for major page titles).

visual_enhancers.borders: Thin borders everywhere. 1px solid using the specified border hex tokens. Engineered, not decorative.
visual_enhancers.radius: Default 4px, Medium 6px, Large 12px. Sharp corners with subtle rounding. NO fully rounded/pill shapes for large containers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid large soft shadows. Rely on border outlines for depth and crispness.
visual_enhancers.tooltips: Deep navy background (#012652), white highly legible text, 4px radius.
visual_enhancers.transparency: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.

component_name.reconciliation_workbench: Dense table, side-by-side ledgers (Source A/B/C), vertical pass-trace timeline, right-side evidence drawer.
component_name.metric_cards: Compact cards with sparklines, strict 1px border. No excessive internal padding.
component_name.copilot_panel: Split-view agent surface on the right side of the screen. Incorporate citation cards. Not a full-screen chat.
component_name.exception_command_center: Grouped by taxonomy/rail. Focus on bulk triage checkboxes and SLA/Value-at-risk sorting.
component_name.sidebar: High-contrast Prussian Blue (#012652). Compact icons. Sections: Overview, Batches, Recon Workbench, Exceptions, Reports, Audit Logs, Copilot, Admin.

grids.dashboard_metrics: Grid of 4 to 5 columns depending on screen size. Tight gaps (gap-4).
grids.data_density: Maximize pixel utilization. Use compact paddings (e.g., p-2, p-4 max) to fit maximum reconciliation rows on a single viewport.

layouts.architecture: Fixed Left Sidebar (Prussian Blue) + Main Scrolling Canvas (Light/Dark bg).
layouts.canvas: Precise, institutional, white/light canvas with strong blue action hierarchy.
layouts.split_view: When viewing exceptions or using Copilot, shift the main content to 60-70% width and open a fixed right panel (30-40% width).

motion.transitions: Fast, precise, deterministic (100ms - 150ms). Slide-ins for evidence drawers. No bouncy, playful spring animations.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain strict high-contrast text rendering. Muted text must still be legible (WCAG AA).
accessibility.focus_states: Razorpay blue (#0d94fb) 2px focus ring with a 1px offset on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Apply data-testid to every button, tab, table row, and input (e.g., 'approve-exception-btn', 'recon-row-id').

media.icons: Use compact, sharp icons (Lucide React or Phosphor React). Documentation-tool feel, not consumer SaaS.

3d_libraries.usage: NONE. This is a strict 2D, data-dense financial control tower. 3D objects are forbidden here.

steps: Configure Tailwind with exact Razorpay Blade design tokens (colors, fonts, radius).
Set up full height layout with fixed Prussian Blue sidebar and dynamic navigation states.
Build standard Dashboard View with dense metric cards and sparklines.
Construct the dense Reconciliation Workbench table with monospace ID columns and status pills.
Implement the Exception Command Center with bulk actions.
Build the split-view Finance Copilot drawer with citation blocks.
Ensure complete light and dark mode parity.
instructions_to_main_agent: BUILD FOR OPERATORS: Ensure data density is prioritized. Do not use generic SaaS fluffy padding.
STRICT COLORS: Use only the Razorpay Blade color hexes provided in the tokens. Do not introduce outside colors.
TYPOGRAPHY RESTRAINT: Enforce monospace fonts strictly for all financial IDs, amounts, and hashes.
COMPONENT RE-USE: Build modular table components, status pills, and right-drawers that can be repurposed across ledgers.
Ensure all components use Javascript (.js) rather than Typescript (.tsx) for implementation, respecting the environment context.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Add specific properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern, sharp button styles with deterministic interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡. Use professional icons.
Create depth through layered design elements and subtle borders rather than heavy drop-shadows.
Use sonner for toast notifications. Location should be /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
